playbook: Receipts and order confirmations get "Receipts". Flights and hotels get "Travel". Mail from @kettleby.test or @lumenridge.test is "Clients" and stays in the inbox. Newsletters and product updates get "Newsletters" and are done. Shipping notices, calendar acceptances and verification codes are done. Schedule changes and cancellations stay in the inbox. Security alerts and payment problems stay in the inbox. Colleague FYIs that need nothing from me, and short acknowledgements that need no answer, are done. Bills due more than a few days out are reminded two days before they are due. Cold sales pitches and recruiter outreach are done unless I have written to the sender before.
